issues.observed: The first combined memory and worktree discovery probe exceeded ten seconds and returned no complete result.
issues.recovery: Split memory registry lookup from exact worktree inspection and increase only the bounded read timeout.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep memory, filesystem, and Git discovery as independent scalar probes.

issues.observed: The first registry read addressed MEMORY.md relative to the current directory and received file-not-found.
issues.recovery: Use the exact memory-root literal path supplied by the desktop context.
issues.recurrence_guard: Resolve memory paths from the declared memory base rather than the repository working directory.

issues.observed: The corrected memory-registry ripgrep probe exceeded ten seconds without a complete result.
issues.recovery: Use bounded Select-String and exact line reads for the small set of relevant entries.
issues.recurrence_guard: Prefer exact registry sections over a broad search when continuity keywords are already known.

issues.observed: A combined source HEAD, branch, status, and remote-state probe exceeded its bound without complete evidence.
issues.recovery: Run exact HEAD, branch, tracked, untracked, upstream, tracking, and live-remote probes separately.
issues.recurrence_guard: Split local Git state from network and large-worktree status checks.

issues.observed: The D-first additive worktree command exceeded its outer bound after the intended branch, path, and exact HEAD had been created.
issues.recovery: Audit worktree registration, branch, HEAD, process and lock state, and cleanliness; do not retry the mutation.
issues.recurrence_guard: After any mutating timeout, inspect durable state before deciding whether recovery is needed.

issues.observed: A read-only Git process inventory emitted rows but returned nonzero because a process disappeared during property collection.
issues.recovery: Repeat only a scalar Git-process count after quiescence and verify zero active processes and locks.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use stable scalar process counts before optional detail collection on short-lived processes.

issues.observed: The first working-tree diff-quiet check exceeded its bound and produced no complete cleanliness evidence.
issues.recovery: Use bounded porcelain status without untracked files, then a separate untracked-path query.
issues.recurrence_guard: Avoid whole-tree diff traversal when exact status categories provide the needed invariant.

issues.observed: The first novelty summary piped directly from a PowerShell foreach expression and failed with an empty pipeline element.
issues.recovery: Materialize proposal rows before formatting and keep novelty computation inside the phase builder.
issues.recurrence_guard: Assign foreach output to a variable before every PowerShell pipeline.

issues.observed: A test inspection passed a Windows wildcard as a literal ripgrep filename and returned invalid-path syntax.
issues.recovery: Use rg glob options or enumerate exact file paths before searching.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never pass an unexpanded Windows wildcard as a positional filename to ripgrep.

issues.observed: A narrow two-file symbol search still exceeded fifteen seconds on the large Windows worktree.
issues.recovery: Inspect one exact file at a time with bounded Select-String and a larger read-only timeout.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep large-worktree inspection literal, one file per probe, with explicit bounds.

issues.observed: A combined multi-pattern catalogue inspection exceeded twenty seconds without output.
issues.recovery: Use one bounded ripgrep call with a small match cap and a longer read-only timeout.
issues.recurrence_guard: Prefer indexed exact-pattern probes over full PowerShell line materialization for large files.

issues.observed: Even a short Get-Item probe exceeded fifteen seconds during transient Windows filesystem latency.
issues.recovery: Allow the filesystem to quiesce and repeat only the exact indexed search with a bounded sixty-second ceiling.
issues.recurrence_guard: Treat transient read latency as zero-credit evidence and avoid stacking concurrent filesystem probes.

issues.observed: A large semantic replacement was rejected because terminal-rendered UTF-8 text did not match the file's actual bytes; no file changed.
issues.recovery: Use ASCII-safe declaration anchors and activate new lists without matching rendered Unicode context.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never use terminal mojibake as patch context; anchor semantic edits on exact ASCII syntax.

issues.observed: A broader overview replacement was also rejected at a terminal-rendered Unicode boundary and changed nothing.
issues.recovery: Leave the inherited template function inert, add a new UTF-8 function at an ASCII-only declaration boundary, and select it explicitly.
issues.recurrence_guard: Prefer additive UTF-8 replacement functions over repeated context matching when inherited rendered bytes are uncertain.

issues.observed: The running Codex executable exposed neither file-version nor product-version metadata.
issues.recovery: Read the installed OpenAI.Codex Appx package version without changing package state.
issues.recurrence_guard: Use the signed package registry as the desktop version source when executable metadata is empty.

issues.observed: A multi-file count update included a literal patch-prefix character in its expected source context and was rejected without changing either file.
issues.recovery: Split the update by file and use the exact source line without patch-control characters.
issues.recurrence_guard: Keep multi-file patches small and inspect literal hunk context before applying.

issues.observed: The first Ilyra source model treated Lyren's 15,246 closeout count plus two final-preparation failures as external, although the committed final register already retains both and reports 15,248.
issues.recovery: Inspect the authoritative final negative-register fields, preserve 15,248 as the sealed activation baseline, and add no invented external count.
issues.recurrence_guard: Read closeout_effective_count, final_preparation_count, and effective_count together before modelling inherited totals.

issues.observed: The first x1 build stopped before packet writes because the expected baton digest described CRLF checkout bytes rather than the immutable Git blob.
issues.recovery: Measure both domains, bind the builder to the exact source-commit Git-blob SHA-256, and retain the checkout digest as a separate receipt field.
issues.recurrence_guard: Declare the hash domain for every historical content seal before validation.

issues.observed: The second x1 build stopped before packet writes because proposal 22 scored 0.7000 and proposal 27 scored 0.7619 against Lyren semantic neighbors, above the frozen 0.60 threshold.
issues.recovery: Rewrite both mechanisms around distinct amendment-graph and purpose-matrix contracts, then rerun the unchanged all-2,440-title tribunal.
issues.recurrence_guard: Never lower the novelty threshold to admit a duplicate; rewrite or reject the proposal.

issues.observed: The first current-label search included the one-line 2,440-row frozen proposal index, producing an oversized inherited-history listing that was truncated and could not prove current-label hygiene.
issues.recovery: Exclude declared ancestry and nearest-neighbor evidence files, then scan all remaining current phase surfaces with the unchanged stale-label patterns.
issues.recurrence_guard: Separate historical evidence fields from current lifecycle-label scans and cap diagnostic output.
